Lina (People Ops): FYI 1 MeI accepted offer. She currently has an EAD based on pending VAWA adjustment and expects approval timeline unclear. She asked if we can start 2026-08-01 and enroll in benefits. Thoughts? cc @Priya
Diego (Hiring Manager): Team is ready to onboard 8/1. If doc risk is high, we can push 2 weeks. What's the payroll/I-9 stance?
Mei (Candidate): I have my physical EAD card now but it's labeled "employment authorized until 2026-09-15". I'll upload scans. My attorney filed AOS and said EAD could be reissued but timeline unknown. I'd prefer to start on 8/1.
Priya (Immigration Counsel): Good news: an unexpired EAD card (List A) is sufficient for I-9 and employment. Even if underlying AOS is pending, the card authorizes work through its expiration. Recommend collecting copy of EAD + passport for I-9 Section 2. If EAD expires while employed, we must follow reverification rules.
Omar (Payroll): If EAD valid on start date, payroll can process. We'll need SSN (or confirm existing), and retained copies of supporting docs. If EAD expires mid-year, payroll will await new EAD or other proof; if none, cannot continue paying. For tax setup we need accurate dates.
Rae (Benefits): Carriers accept enrollment based on hire date; they generally don't check immigration status, but we need payroll to be active. We can make coverage effective 8/1. If EAD later lapses and employment stops, coverage termination rules apply. I'll prepare a benefits note for Mei about documentation and premium responsibilities.
Lina (People Ops): Action items: (1) Mei upload EAD + passport to secure portal (2) Omar to confirm SSN records and payroll checklist (3) Priya to note reverification timeline if EAD expires mid-employment (4) Rae to draft benefits memo.
hr-bot: Reminder: do not post scans here. Use secure portal.
Mei (Candidate): Uploaded EAD and passport. I do have an SSN already.
Omar (Payroll): Confirmed SSN in HRIS. I'll queue payroll activation for 8/1 and attach EAD copy. We'll add a reverification reminder 30 days before EAD expiration (9/15). If Mei gets a renewal receipt, we'll review receipt-rule applicability then.
Priya (Immigration Counsel): Quick note on receipt rule: some receipt notices grant an automatic extension for certain categories, but VAWA/AOS-related EAD renewals historically are not guaranteed the 180/240-day extension. We'll treat any receipt as helpful but not rely on it; request candidate to share receipt when filed. I'll set a calendar reminder to review if she files.
Rae (Benefits): Drafted memo: benefits effective 8/1, premiums start with first payroll. If EAD later lapses and employment ends, coverage will terminate per plan terms; employee may be eligible for COBRA. I'll attach FAQ about dependent enrollment and SSN timing.
Diego (Hiring Manager): Appreciate clarity. If EAD expires before renewal, can we transition Mei to contractor briefly while legal sorts it?
Priya (Immigration Counsel): Contractor arrangement is risky: must ensure classification, separate contracting agreement, and confirm no unauthorized work. If employee loses work authorization, they cannot legally perform services (employee or contractor) until new authorization. We should avoid contractor stop-gap. Better to delay work or place on unpaid leave until authorization restored.
Omar (Payroll): Agreed. Payroll cannot process wages without authorization. We can prepare a contingency plan (pause payroll, hold equipment) but not pay for unauthorized work.
Lina (People Ops): Noted. Mei, sounds like 8/1 works since EAD valid. Please notify People Ops immediately if you file for renewal so Priya & Payroll can assess. Welcome aboard!
Mei (Candidate): Thank you 1 I'll ping as soon as anything changes. Excited to join. :smile:
